# SoFlo UnderPressure

> Pressure washing and soft washing company serving Miami-Dade and Broward County, Florida. Owner-run and owner-operated. Residential, commercial, and HOA / property-management work. Flat, upfront pricing - no hourly rates.

Contact: (305) 894-6336 · SoFlo.Underpressure@gmail.com
Service area: Miami-Dade County and Broward County, Florida
Hours: Sun - Thu 8am - 8pm, Fri 8am - 3pm

## Services

- [Pressure Washing & Soft Washing (overview)](https://sofloup.com/services): Every surface we clean, pricing, and how we match method to material.
- [Soft Washing](https://sofloup.com/services/soft-washing): Low-pressure cleaning (~100 PSI) that kills algae at the root. Safe for roofs, stucco, paint, siding, and screens.
- [Roof Soft Washing](https://sofloup.com/services/roof-soft-washing): Algae and black-streak removal using the only method roofing manufacturers endorse. From $349.
- [House Soft Washing](https://sofloup.com/services/house-soft-washing): Full exterior soft wash for stucco and painted surfaces. From $279.
- [Driveway Pressure Washing](https://sofloup.com/services/driveway-pressure-washing): Concrete and paver cleaning with a surface cleaner for even results. From $119.
- [Patio & Pool Deck Cleaning](https://sofloup.com/services/patio-pool-deck-cleaning): Travertine, natural stone, and pavers cleaned at safe pressure. From $149.
- [Fence Cleaning](https://sofloup.com/services/fence-cleaning): Wood, vinyl, aluminum, and chain-link at pressure matched to the material. From $109.
- [Commercial Storefront Cleaning](https://sofloup.com/services/commercial-storefront-cleaning): Sidewalks, entryways, and facades cleaned before you open.

## Plans & commercial

- [Recurring Service Plans](https://sofloup.com/membership): Same service on a schedule, cheaper per visit. Humble Brag 1x/year from $198. Bragging Rights 2x/year from $187 per visit (15% off each visit). The Show-Off 4x/year from $165 per visit (25% off each visit). Any surface at the plan rate.
- [HOA & Property Managers](https://sofloup.com/hoa-property-managers): Multi-unit and community work on one contract, one point of contact.

## Pricing (starting prices, small area, light buildup)

- Driveway $119 · Walkway $89 · Fence $109 · Patio or pool deck $149 · Screen enclosure / pool cage $139 · House soft wash $279 · Roof soft wash $349. Minimum job $109.
- Prices are set by area: Miami-Dade core is the base rate; outer areas and Broward run 5-15% higher; Miami Beach, Surfside and Bal Harbour run 25% higher. The instant quote shows the exact area price.
- Extra surfaces cleaned in the same visit are discounted. Size, heavy buildup, two-story homes and tile roofs raise the price.
- The flat price is confirmed before anything is scheduled. No hourly rates.

## How to book

1. Get an instant estimate in a few taps: https://sofloup.com/instant-quote (or call/text (305) 894-6336).
2. We text back a flat price, usually within a few hours during business hours.
3. Pick a time. Same-week appointments are usually available. Most jobs take a few hours.
